gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-momo-trust-san: Marker-bold and cheerful up top. Momo Trust Sans follows with heavy bowls and wide-mouthed curves, and it would feel crowded if the heading shrank too far.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-mona-sans: Red Hat Display draws every stroke at a single marker width, with no thick-thin swing, while daylight fills each curve. Mona Sans follows with wide letter openings, so the page feels easy.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-monda: Red Hat Display has flat, contrast-free letterforms that look drawn with one marker, curves left open to the light. Monda adds sans-serif text with uncramped small counters.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-mooli: No hairline anywhere, just a steady marker line. Mooli backs it up with open, round letters that stay clear at small sizes, so the page feels tidy and modern.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and tidy, its s curves opening wide at both ends. Red Hat Display, hairline-free, leads with a bold marker line, and Murecho keeps a long passage moving smoothly beneath it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic reads with wide channels leading into each counter, which makes the sans feel open and businesslike. And Red Hat Display above it has a pen-plotter smoothness, bold but gentle on the eye.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-national-park: Rounded, bold, and unhurried in the hand. National Park keeps its pen at constant pressure and angle, with a clearly open side on each round letter, so a long passage feels like one smooth line.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-niramit: Niramit has gaping curves that make its sans text look generous and tidy. And Red Hat Display, with a rounded-wire stroke, stays in the background, so a long passage moves along steadily.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-cana: Red Hat Display looks like letters bent from a single length of wire, bold and daylit in every curve. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal opens every curve end, so a long passage feels light.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-cypr: Red Hat Display looks like glass tubing bent into letters, bold, with daylight showing inside every curve. It is best at announcing; Noto Sans Cypriot is best at quietly carrying the text.
